### Favorite Books

I really like books about identity, family, culture, and just people trying to figure things out. I especially love stories about people caught between different worlds whether that be different cultures, generations, expectations, or just who they are and who other people think they should be. And then there are some books on here that I just really liked, no deeper explanation needed.
